北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感-2℃，记得多穿衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is chilly, feels like -2℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 3℃。注意添衣，别着凉啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 3℃. Add layers to avoid catching a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 2℃。外出记得多加件外套哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels like 2℃. Remember an extra jacket when you go out!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 16℃。天气凉爽，注意适时增减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 16℃. It's cool, dress appropriately.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 16℃。微凉，小心别着凉了。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 16℃. A bit cool, be careful not to catch a cold.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴冷，体感 5℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水润润喉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cool, feels like 5℃. It's dry, remember to hydrate!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴冷，体感-2℃，风力 3级。出门务必做好防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and freezing, feels like -2℃ with level 3 wind. Bundle up before going out!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴冷潮湿，体感 6℃。注意保暖，小心湿冷感冒哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, damp, and cool, feels like 6℃. Stay warm and watch out for damp-cold!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 0℃。出行注意安全，记得添衣保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 0℃. Stay safe when out and about, and dress warmly.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 8℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水润润嗓。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 8℃. It's very dry, remember to drink plenty of water.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃。注意保暖，别让凉风吹着啦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 8℃. Stay warm and avoid the cool breeze.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨严寒，体感-9℃。出门务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing, feels like -9℃. Bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 1℃。出门注意保暖，别感冒了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 1℃. Dress warmly when going out to avoid catching a cold.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，有 4级风。风力稍大，出门注意防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny with level 4 wind. The wind is a bit strong, be mindful of it outdoors.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意适时增减衣物。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 10℃. Big temperature difference between day and night, dress accordingly.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感-4℃，风力 3级。海边风大，注意防寒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and freezing, feels like -4℃ with level 3 wind. It's windy by the sea, bundle up!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感-3℃，风力 3级。海边风大，注意防风保暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and freezing, feels like -3℃ with level 3 wind. It's windy by the sea, stay warm and sheltered from wind!
